description: This file is a shell script for testing Windows-specific path handling in Git. It includes setup, conditionals for different environments (Cygwin, MinGW), and performs various tests related to Windows path formats, UNC paths, and Git operations with paths.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for specific prerequisites in the environment such as CYGWIN or MINGW.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for specific patterns in command output or files.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.

calls: test_expect_success 'clone with backslashed path' 'git clone "$BACKSLASHED" backslashed'
